decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-171 MODIFY recording the selected tighter kerning, common baseline, E/L height alignment to the second V’s left arm, and resulting cap-height hierarchy.
The candidate’s existing message-171 MODIFY already records that the second V’s left arm establishes the E/L height and its right arm remains the sole slightly elevated mid-word element.
Scaling the E and L relative to the second V does not change the locked Hero V geometry or any of its current attributes.
The request for a perfect copy/paste reiterates the already-current literal Hero-terminal derivation and exact Bézier-copy requirements; it does not change the accent requirement.
The source reiterates the existing rule that the Hero V right-arm gesture is copied exactly to the É accent; the E/L height adjustment does not alter the shared terminal treatment.
The specific E/L scaling and second-V hierarchy refinement does not modify the project’s broader brand-expression requirements.
The source concerns letter heights, hierarchy, kerning, and accent geometry, not the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
The composition refinement leaves unchanged the requirement that the identity remain wordmark-led without a separate icon or monogram.
